summary: Server Anubis debugging, one frame: the tree view (a serialized description of an entity's behaviour tree) built by bg3.exe+0x3830880 for a debugged entity, which also gets ls::anubis::debug::HistoryComponent. Never seen alive.

fields.name: TextStart
fields.evidence: Windows TreeView::AddNode bg3.exe+0x38836B0: *node = CONCAT44(end, start) where start = the text size (+0x20) before the node's label is appended.

fields.name: TextEnd
fields.evidence: same store: the text size after the label is appended (clamped to start).

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x38836B0: = kind & 0xF | bool << 4 | bool << 5 (macOS AddNode(..., ETreeNodeKind, bool, bool, int, int, int): the node kind in the low 4 bits and two flags).

fields.name: Depth
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x38836B0: 0 for a root, else the parent's +9 plus one.

fields.name: Parent
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x38836B0: = the parent index argument (negative for a root; the parent's depth is read at nodes + index * 0x10 + 9).

fields.name: NameStart
fields.evidence: The component is an ls::anubis::debug::TreeView (Windows constructor bg3.exe+0x3883600, called by the builder bg3.exe+0x3865F80 and moved in by the creator bg3.exe+0x383ACA0 (AllocRaw 0x38)): +0 = CONCAT44(end, start) of the tree's name in the text buffer; start = text size before it was appended.

fields.name: NameEnd
fields.evidence: same store: end of the name in the text buffer.

fields.name: Nodes
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3883600 allocates capacity * 0x10 bytes for +8 (capacity +0x10, size +0x14); AddNode bg3.exe+0x38836B0 appends 16-byte nodes; destructor bg3.exe+0x38834C0 clears it as a plain array (bg3.exe+0x5BD630) and frees it.

fields.name: Text
fields.evidence: Character buffer of the tree's labels: the constructor appends the name with bg3.exe+0x411A610 to +0x18, AddNode appends each label; the destructor frees it only when OwnsBuffer (+0x31) is set.

fields.name: TextSize
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3883600 / 0x38836B0 read the current text size here (start offset of the next label); macOS TreeView::AddNode updates it.

fields.name: TextCapacity
fields.evidence: constructor zeroes it (8-byte store with +0x20); macOS AddNode compares the required size with it before reallocating.

fields.name: field_28
fields.evidence: constructor writes 0xFFFFFFFF (one 8-byte store of -1 over +0x28..+0x2F); macOS AddNode treats +0x28 as a size limit (0 = write nothing, -1 = unlimited).

fields.name: CanGrow
fields.evidence: constructor writes 0x101 to +0x30 (two bytes = 1); macOS AddNode reallocates the text buffer only when +0x30 and +0x31 are both set.

fields.name: OwnsBuffer
fields.evidence: destructor bg3.exe+0x38834C0 and bg3.exe+0x3883520 free the pointer at +0x18 only when this byte is non-zero; default 1.

open_questions: Meaning of node +0xC/+0xE and of the two -1 defaults at +0x28/+0x2C.
